Status: wave 329: 104 Falcon rows named from the released 6.4 surface by normalized signature shape

Method.evidence: The 6.4 tree carries released names where 6.3 is obfuscated, so each row was joined to the 6.4 build by normalized signature shape: every 6.3 type name is replaced by the alias the 6.3 map already gives it, namespaces and generic arity are dropped, and the join must be unique on both sides. A 6.4 row counts as released only when the 6.4 map has no row for its token, so a name this pass assigned earlier cannot be mistaken for evidence. 105 Falcon rows were proposed; the tool suffixed one accessor (0x06002357 get_Item -> get_Item2, a real pre-existing indexer in that scope) and that row was dropped, leaving 104.
Method.themes: Falcon. The 6.4 tree (ETS6.4_api_preserved5) is the oracle for the released surface; graph64-v3.sqlite is stale (built 2026-09-12 from the pre-rename tree). The same join applies to every module once a fresh --review inventory of the 6.4 tree exists; accessor-shaped candidates (get_/set_) can collide with property rows that ro63 does not carry, so a two-pass check (run, drop the suffixed rows, re-run) keeps the wave's suffix gate at 0.
